prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: one square full bleed WeChat mini game app icon for 猜数字暗号, a couples four digit guessing game.
Primary request: refined youthful romantic icon, understated and stylish rather than cute, childish or plush. Theme "a secret code between us".
Subject: two overlapping elegant ivory playing cards, slightly opposing angles as a pair, on a rich muted burgundy background. Front card has one very large burgundy question mark, rear card a very large readable numeral 2 in muted rose. A small red heart suit mark near the front card corner provides a subtle romantic detail. Only these two cards and small heart; minimal recognizable silhouette.
Style: contemporary editorial graphic illustration with subtle printed paper texture and crisp typography, flat broad colors and a restrained soft shadow giving paper depth. Stylish boutique board game aesthetic suitable for young adult couples of any gender.
Composition: centered large emblem within middle 75% of image, bold readable when reduced to a tiny avatar, ample full bleed background safe for circle cropping.
Avoid: faces, animals, mascots, hands, kawaii, clay, inflated plastic, excessive hearts, candy pastel pink, gradients, ornate gold borders, Chinese text, words, watermark, outer app frame.
Text only: "2" and "?" as large typography on separate cards.
